import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { open, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path'
import { AttemptClientError, createAttemptClient } from '@jigging/jig/client'

let stage = 'inspect'
let mode: string | undefined
process.on('uncaughtExceptionMonitor', error => {
  console.error('Foundation client failure: ' + JSON.stringify({
    application: 'evaluation-deadline', stage, mode,
    ...(error instanceof AttemptClientError
      ? { code: error.code, operation: error.operation, uncertain: error.uncertain } : {}),
  }))
})
interface Stream { text: string; truncated: boolean }
interface File { path: string; bytes: number; digest: string }
interface Process {
  invocation: string[]; exitCode: number | null; signal: string | null;
  stopReason: string | null; durationMs: number | null; stdout: Stream | null; stderr: Stream | null;
}
interface Phase extends Process {
  phase: string; status: string; stopReason: string; durationMs: number;
  stdout: Stream; stderr: Stream; files: File[];
}
interface Evaluation {
  candidateDigest: string | null; recipeDigest: string | null; dependencyDigest: string | null;
  environmentDigest: string | null; phase: string | null; stage: string; limit: string | null;
  phases: Phase[]; process: Process | null;
  files: File[] | null; cleanup: string;
}
function manifest(files: File[]) {
  assert.ok(Array.isArray(files) && files.length <= 64)
  for (const file of files) {
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(file).sort(), ['bytes', 'digest', 'path'])
    assert.match(file.path, /^(generated|dist|reports)\/[A-Za-z0-9_@./-]+$/)
    assert.ok(Number.isSafeInteger(file.bytes) && file.bytes >= 0 && file.bytes <= 2 * 1024 * 1024)
    assert.match(file.digest, /^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$/)
  }
  return files.map(file => [file.path, file.bytes, file.digest])
}
const cwd = process.cwd()
const client = createAttemptClient({ executable: resolve(process.argv[2]!), cwd, timeoutMs: 195_000 })
const inspected = await client.inspect({ target: 'binding:root' }) as { approval: string }
assert.match(inspected.approval, /^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$/)
const runs: string[] = []
const evidence: Evaluation[] = []
for (const selected of ['generation', 'test'] as const) {
  mode = selected
  stage = 'run'
  const execution = await client.run({
    expectedApproval: inspected.approval, target: 'binding:root', input: { mode }, files: [],
    constraints: { durationMs: 120_000, resultBytes: 1_048_576, artifactBytes: 8_388_608 },
    outputIntent: { packet: false, receive: [] },
  }, {
    persist: async prepared => {
      const file = await open(join(cwd, `${mode}-prepared.json`), 'wx', 0o600)
      try { await file.writeFile(JSON.stringify(prepared)); await file.sync() }
      finally { await file.close() }
      const directory = await open(cwd, 'r')
      try { await directory.sync() } finally { await directory.close() }
    },
  })
  stage = 'run-terminal'
  assert.equal(execution.role, 'owner')
  assert.equal(execution.observation?.terminal?.status, 'succeeded')
  assert.equal(execution.observation?.cleanup, 'confirmed')
  stage = 'result'
  const retained = await client.result({ ticket: execution.prepared.ticket })
  const output = retained.output as {
    mode: string; code: string; details: { evaluation: Evaluation }; remainingAfterMs: number;
  }
  stage = 'result-header'
  assert.equal(output.mode, mode)
  assert.equal(output.code, 'DEADLINE_EXCEEDED')
  assert.ok(output.remainingAfterMs > 0)
  const evaluation = output.details.evaluation
  const phase = selected === 'generation' ? 'generate' : 'test'
  assert.equal(evaluation.phase, phase)
  assert.equal(evaluation.cleanup, 'complete')
  assert.ok(['phase', 'evaluation'].includes(evaluation.limit!))
  assert.ok(['preparation', 'sealing', 'admission', 'collection', 'settlement'].includes(evaluation.stage))
  for (const key of ['candidateDigest', 'recipeDigest', 'dependencyDigest', 'environmentDigest'] as const)
    assert.match(evaluation[key]!, /^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$/)
  stage = 'phase-evidence'
  const priorPhases = selected === 'generation' ? [] : ['generate', 'compile']
  assert.ok(evaluation.phases.length === priorPhases.length ||
    evaluation.phases.length === priorPhases.length + 1)
  const prior = evaluation.phases.slice(0, priorPhases.length)
  assert.deepEqual(prior.map(p => p.phase), priorPhases)
  for (const completed of prior) {
    assert.equal(completed.status, 'completed')
    assert.equal(completed.exitCode, 0)
    assert.equal(completed.signal, null)
    assert.equal(completed.stopReason, 'exited')
    manifest(completed.files)
  }
  const stopped = evaluation.phases[priorPhases.length]
  if (stopped === undefined) assert.equal(evaluation.files, null)
  else {
    assert.equal(stopped.phase, phase)
    assert.equal(stopped.status, 'failed')
    assert.equal(stopped.stopReason, 'deadline')
    assert.ok(Number.isFinite(stopped.durationMs) && stopped.durationMs > 0)
    assert.ok(evaluation.files !== null)
    assert.deepEqual(manifest(evaluation.files), manifest(stopped.files))
  }
  stage = 'process-evidence'
  const process = evaluation.process
  assert.ok(process !== null)
  assert.equal(process.stopReason, 'deadline')
  assert.ok(typeof process.durationMs === 'number' &&
    Number.isFinite(process.durationMs) && process.durationMs > 0)
  assert.deepEqual(process.invocation, selected === 'generation'
    ? ['bun', 'tools/generate.js'] : ['bun', 'test', 'test/answer.test.js'])
  assert.ok(process.stdout !== null && process.stderr !== null)
  if (stopped !== undefined) {
    assert.equal(stopped.exitCode, process.exitCode)
    assert.equal(stopped.signal, process.signal)
    assert.deepEqual([stopped.stdout.text, stopped.stdout.truncated],
      [process.stdout.text, process.stdout.truncated])
    assert.deepEqual([stopped.stderr.text, stopped.stderr.truncated],
      [process.stderr.text, process.stderr.truncated])
  }
  stage = 'process-logs'
  assert.match(process.stdout.text, new RegExp(`deadline-${selected}-start`))
  assert.equal(process.stdout.truncated, true)
  assert.match(process.stderr.text, /cwd:\/work\n/)
  assert.match(process.stderr.text, new RegExp(`module:/work/${selected === 'generation' ? 'tools/generate' : 'test/answer.test'}\\.js\\n`))
  stage = 'log-bounds'
  for (const observed of [...evaluation.phases, process])
    for (const stream of [observed.stdout, observed.stderr]) {
      assert.ok(stream !== null)
      assert.ok(Buffer.byteLength(stream.text) <= 8 * 1024)
      assert.equal(typeof stream.truncated, 'boolean')
    }
  stage = 'prior-compile'
  if (selected === 'generation') assert.equal(evaluation.limit, 'phase')
  else {
    const compile = evaluation.phases.find(p => p.phase === 'compile')!
    assert.equal(compile.status, 'completed')
    assert.equal(compile.exitCode, 0)
    assert.equal(compile.stopReason, 'exited')
    assert.match(evaluation.phases[0]!.stdout.text, /generate-complete/)
  }
  stage = 'repeated-result'
  const repeated = await client.result({ ticket: execution.prepared.ticket })
  assert.deepEqual(repeated.output, retained.output)
  assert.equal(repeated.observation.receipt?.runId, execution.receipt.runId)
  assert.equal(repeated.observation.cleanup, 'confirmed')
  stage = 'lookup-cleanup'
  const lookup = await client.lookup({ ticket: execution.prepared.ticket })
  assert.equal(lookup.cleanup, 'confirmed')
  assert.equal(lookup.receipt?.runId, execution.receipt.runId)
  runs.push(execution.receipt.runId)
  evidence.push(evaluation)
}
stage = 'run-identities'
assert.equal(new Set(runs).size, 2)
assert.notEqual(evidence[0]!.candidateDigest, evidence[1]!.candidateDigest)
for (const key of ['recipeDigest', 'dependencyDigest', 'environmentDigest'] as const)
  assert.equal(evidence[0]![key], evidence[1]![key])
stage = 'approval'
assert.equal((await client.inspect({ target: 'binding:root' }) as { approval: string }).approval,
  inspected.approval)
stage = 'save-verification'
await writeFile('verified.json', JSON.stringify({
  application: 'evaluation-deadline', cleanup: 'confirmed', runs, phases: ['generate', 'test'],
}), { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 })
